title: Certificate Tracker Home Page
description: My WDD 231 home page, with an About section, the courses in my Web and Computer Programming certificate, and a running credit total.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the Certificate Tracker home page with the About section and course list

title: Course Filter and Credit Counter
description: Buttons filter the certificate course list to all, WDD or CSE courses, and the total credits are recalculated with the reduce array method.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the course filter buttons above the certificate course list and credit total

title: Responsive Hamburger Navigation
description: A shared navigation module that opens and closes the menu on small screens, updates aria-expanded and the button label, and closes the menu after a link is chosen.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the open mobile menu with the Home, Chamber and Final links

title: Abuja Chamber of Commerce Home
description: The home page of my Abuja Chamber of Commerce class site, with a hero banner, upcoming events, live weather and a member spotlight.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the Abuja Chamber of Commerce home page with its skyline hero banner

title: Abuja Weather and Forecast
description: Fetches the current temperature and conditions for Abuja from the OpenWeatherMap API and builds a three-day forecast from the reading closest to noon on each day.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the Abuja Weather panel showing the current temperature and a three-day forecast

title: Member Spotlight
description: Loads the chamber's member businesses from a JSON file and randomly features two or three gold or silver members each time the page loads.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the Member Spotlight section with featured member business cards

title: Chamber Member Directory
description: Fetches the chamber's member businesses from a JSON file and shows each one as a card with its logo, address, phone number, website and membership level.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the chamber member directory showing business cards in a grid

title: Grid and List View Toggle
description: Two buttons switch the member directory between a card grid and compact table-style rows by re-rendering the data and swapping CSS classes.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the member directory in list view with the Grid and List buttons

title: Membership Application Form
description: A membership form with required fields, pattern validation for the job title, autocomplete hints and a hidden timestamp, submitted with the GET method.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the membership application form beside the membership level cards

title: Membership Benefit Modals
description: Each membership level opens its own native dialog listing its benefits, which closes with a button or a backdrop click, and the level cards animate in with CSS keyframes.
imageAlt: Screenshot of an open dialog listing the benefits of a membership level

title: Application Thank-You Page
description: Reads the submitted application from the URL with URLSearchParams and shows the applicant's details with a formatted submission time.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the thank-you page listing the details from a sample application

title: Discover Abuja Page
description: Eight cards about places to visit in Abuja, built from a JavaScript data module, with images that load lazily depending on where they sit on the screen.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the Discover Abuja page with its welcome message and place cards

title: Three Named-Grid-Area Layouts
description: The Discover cards use a different grid-template-areas layout for small, medium and large screens, with cards that span columns and rows.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the large-screen Discover layout with wide and tall place cards

title: Last-Visit Message
description: Uses localStorage to welcome first-time visitors, say "Back so soon!" within a day, or show how many days have passed since the last visit.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the visit message bar above the Discover Abuja introduction

title: PortFolio Hub Site Plan
description: The plan for this portfolio site: its name, purpose, visitor scenarios, color scheme, typography and mobile and desktop wireframes.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the PortFolio Hub site plan with its navy header
